note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-15. RFC 6810 Section 6.1 requires: 'To limit the length of time a cache must keep the data necessary to generate incremental updates, a router MUST send either a Serial Query or a Reset Query no less frequently than once an hour.' Section 6.2 repeats the hourly obligation. These are version-0 queries in this RFC. New sessions still begin at rtrVersionMax=2; current handlePDU can lower the session version only to a cache-advertised supported version at least rtrVersionMin=1, and syncOnce bounds retries to that supported range. A version-0 cache cannot establish the protocol session being polled. The response-identity and fatal-cleanup repairs add no version-0 query or polling path. This untagged row remains an owed implementation gap; cache-signalled Refresh/Retry behavior in version-1/2 sessions proves neither version-0 operation nor this fixed-hour requirement.
